cat.account.q1: Ez çawa e-mailê li hesabê xwe biguherînim?
cat.account.a1: Email support@globaliqreport.com from the address currently on the account and tell us the new one. We will move it across and confirm when it is done.
cat.account.q2: Ez çawa hesab û daneyên xwe vedişirim?
cat.account.a2:
Email support@globaliqreport.com ji navnîşana hesabê xwe û daxwaza ji bo hilweşandina.

Ev yek bi betalkirina ne. Deleting cancels any active subscription immediately with no refund, permanently erases your results and history, and cannot be undone. If you only want to stop paying, cancel instead.

Requests are completed within 30 days. We keep limited billing records where tax law requires it.
